description: Copies a published Hub strategy, applies `changes` (nested fields merged, e.g. {"signal": {"lookback": 126}}), re-runs it on the server and publishes the fork linked to its parent. Costs one backtest.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

title: Fork strategy
